note: Locked synthetic persona-language case per exposed operation, one per story turn. Prompts avoid operation names and preserve the rights-team approval boundary.

cases.onepager_bullet: Assesses launch clearance by territory and platform, with the exact contract clause cited for every answer
cases.prompt: Can we put Silver Harbor on our streaming service in the UK, and which contract clause says so?

cases.onepager_bullet: Retrieves distribution windows and holdbacks so teams see which launch dates are open and why
cases.prompt: Programming wants Paper Lantern live in Canada in about a month. Is there a holdback that blocks that date?

cases.onepager_bullet: Checks approval readiness before launch so no title goes live without its sign-off
cases.prompt: Is Northern Signal ready to come to the rights team for sign-off? What is still missing?
